head: 765809978ebd6bc395f20a7d07a73cd762bcaaed
firstBrokenBoundary: native process before Tauri WebView initialization

dialog.title: Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime Library
dialog.message: Debug Assertion Failed! Program: ...\target\debug\jarvis.exe; File: minkernel\crts\ucrt\src\appcrt\heap\debug_heap.cpp; Line: 904; Expression: _CrtIsValidHeapPointer(block)

rootCause.sourceBehavior: build.rs defaults ESPEAK_LIB_PROFILE to Release, but independently emits msvcrtd whenever the Rust crate has debug_assertions on Windows
rootCause.conclusion: Release-built eSpeak objects were linked to the debug CRT in the Rust debug artifact, causing a cross-heap free assertion before WebView startup.
